name: @desk-standard/plugin
description: desk-standard plugin: harness-pure core domain library + stdio MCP server over the D7 data-surface loader.

scripts.package: mkdir -p ../plugins/desk-standard/mcp ../plugins/desk-standard/schema && bun build mcp/server.ts --target=node --outfile ../plugins/desk-standard/mcp/server.js && cp ../schema/profile.schema.yaml ../plugins/desk-standard/schema/profile.schema.yaml && cp ../schema/references.yaml ../plugins/desk-standard/schema/references.yaml
